regions.today: Breezy this evening with sunny spells and scattered showers. There's a small chance of thunder and hail too.
regions.tonight: Cloudy tonight with further showers or longer spells of rain. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees in a moderate to fresh southwest to west wind.
regions.tomorrow: Cool and blustery with widespread showers, merging into longer spells of rain at times. The showers will become less frequent later in the day and more in the way of sunny spells will develop. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees with fresh and gusty westerly winds.
